main_text.head: Caput, 14.
main_text.p: CAput hoc rectam prophetandi .i .rectam ministerialia dona in publico coetu exercen di rationem docet. Primò & præcipuè qua lin-guâ ,vel idiomate sit prophetandum , non pe-regrinâ, vt Corinthiii perperam solebant, sed vernacula, vsque ad vers. 26. Secundo de prophetantium numero & ordine agitur ad vers 34. Tertio de prophetantium sexu vel de mulieribus ab hoc exercitio præstando exclu dendis vers. 34.35. Vltimo in loco cõclusio præ-dictis constitutionibus authoritatem concili-ans adijcitur, vsque ad finem capitis. Ordina-rius peregrinæ linguæ vsus tribus argumentis refellitur. Primum est ab inutili vsque ad verf. 20. inutilitas peregrinae prophetiae ostendi-tur primò à summa vernaculae vtilitate.
Verf. 1. Sectemini charitatem, aemulemini spiritualia, magis autem vt prophetetis.
2 Nam qui lingua loquitur, non hominibus loquitur sed deo: nullus enim audit: spiritus autem loquitur mysteria.
3 At prophetans, hominibus loquitur edificationem & exhortationem & consolationem

page.notes: The first word of the text is a large initial "C" joined to "Caput". The line "minist..." beneath it is partly obscured by the initial; readings in the first lines are doubtful. Greek-free page; the bottom of the page is cut off, so the text ends mid-sentence. The first line is cut at the top; the word "refellitur" is partly obscured. The last word "nem" is a catchword-like fragment at the right, read as the end of "consolationem" continued; treated as part of the text. Some words in the italic lines are uncertain, for example "Sectemini" and "spiritus", which may read differently.
